brand.tagline: Your Minecraft network with an alpine village, a castle and lots of game modes.

home.pitch: Your Minecraft network with an alpine village, a castle and lots of game modes.
home.copyManual: Select the address and copy it by hand.

java.title: Java Edition
java.hint: On PC: Multiplayer → Add Server → paste the address. Version 1.17 or newer.

bedrock.title: Bedrock Edition
bedrock.hint: Phone, console or Windows: Play → Servers → Add Server, enter address and port.

modes.title: Pick your adventure
modes.text: In the lobby you simply talk to a villager – and you are in the game. Empty modes sleep and wake up as soon as someone comes.

soon.title: The village is still growing
soon.text: We are building these parts of the website right now. You will find them here once they are ready.

news.title: News
news.text: What is happening on the network: new modes, updates and events.

discord.title: Discord
discord.text: Our own Discord with live status, help and account linking.

modpack.title: Modpack
modpack.text: Nicer looks, voice chat and building tools – installed with one click.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.text: Best times in Summit Rush, wins in Duels and more.

mode.asleep: Asleep – wakes up as soon as you come
mode.maintenanceText: We are working on it right now.

footer.about: A Minecraft network of our own from Bavaria – with a lobby in an alpine village and game modes to play alone or together.
footer.disclaimer: Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

rules.title: Rules
rules.text: The rules for the whole network will be here soon – short, friendly and easy to understand.

team.title: Team
team.text: The team will introduce itself here soon: who is behind MoinMorni and whom to ask.

imprint.title: Legal notice
imprint.text: The legal notice will follow here once it is ready.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: Soon you will read here which data MoinMorni keeps and why.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.text: Maybe there is a typo. Everything can be found from the start page.

login.title: Team area
login.subtitle: Sign in with your MoinMorni account.
login.passkeyHint: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or a security key – no password needed.
login.twoFactorText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.forTeam: For the team only. You do not need an account to play.

notInTeam.title: You are not on the team (yet)
notInTeam.text: You are signed in, but you have no role in MoinMorni yet. Ask the owner to give you one – then you can continue here.

gate.errorTitle: The panel is not answering right now

setup.title: Welcome to MoinMorni!
setup.text: Create your owner account. You will manage the whole network with it.
setup.codeHelp: The installation script showed the setup code. Lost it? This command on the server shows it:
setup.usernameHelp: 3–32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.
setup.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters – a whole sentence is easier to remember and safe.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.nameInvalid: The name does not fit yet: 3–32 characters, only letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.
setup.passwordShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
setup.doneText: There is an owner account already. Just sign in.

overview.text: How the network is doing, at a glance.
overview.proxyOff: The network's entrance (proxy) is not running right now – players cannot join.

settings.missing: This area does not exist – or you may not see it.

modes.title: Modes
modes.text: Which game modes exist, their order in the lobby and on the website, and who may join.
modes.stateHelp: “Soon” already shows the mode, but nobody can join yet.
modes.sleepHelp: When nobody is inside, the server goes to sleep and saves memory. It wakes up as soon as someone clicks the villager.

roles.title: Roles
roles.text: A role applies everywhere: symbol and colour in chat, rights in game, areas in the panel and the matching role in Discord.
roles.editLater: Editing comes in the next step – until then you see the template here.

servers.title: Servers
servers.text: All of MoinMorni's Minecraft servers: console, files, backups, plugins and more – click a server.
servers.empty: No servers yet. MoinMorni creates them itself when it sets up the network.
servers.motorSignedOut: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.text: This page does not exist in the panel.
